visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is seen sleeping in a passenger airplane seat, fully equipped for rest with a yellow Arc'teryx cap, a white sleep mask reading 'Good Night', a blue surgical mask, a black neck pillow, and earplugs. The cabin background is dimly lit with orange overhead lights. (2) The man begins to stir, using his right hand to lift the brim of his yellow cap and then sliding the sleep mask up to his forehead. His face shows signs of being startled and drowsy, with squinted eyes and a confused facial expression. (3) He proceeds to remove his lime-green earplugs with both hands while simultaneously pulling his blue face mask down below his chin. The camera remains at eye-level as he looks directly ahead, his face appearing puffy and tired from the interrupted sleep. (4) He brings his right index finger to his lips in a shushing motion while looking off-camera. He then leans forward slightly and speaks in a tired manner, his expression suggesting he is trying to process the situation while still mostly asleep.
